title: Steve Agent Arena: Launch Your Agent & Win 500 USDC
gate_reasons: Requires connecting a personal X (Twitter) account and publishing a public post tagging @SteveTheAgentAI and @OOBEonSol — human social identity gate.
Requires sign-in at steve.oobeprotocol.ai with onboarding (handle, display name, avatar) — likely OAuth/human identity gate.
Requires executing at least 5 qualifying trades on Solana Mainnet via the Steve Agent wallet — real-funds gate and anti-wash-trading verification.
Competition is judged on creative content, strategy quality and community contribution (15% weight) — subjective human evaluation not autonomously optimizable.
XP and leaderboard tracking tied to social missions and creator content that assume human authorship and public attribution.
notes: Bounty is a social-trading competition requiring human identity, real funds, and public content creation. No path to fully autonomous completion without violating platform ToS or bounty rules. Payout rail (USDC) is valid but gated by human participation requirements.
